notes: Adjudicated by reading SecondSwap_VestingManager.sol at the pinned commit. `setSellable` admits `s2Admin` or `vestingDeployer` (L174), and at L179-183, when `maxSellPercent` is 0 and the vesting is being made sellable, it writes `maxSellPercent = 2000`. That setting is reserved to a different principal by the contract itself: `setMaxSellPercent` at L194-198 requires `tokenIssuer() == msg.sender`. So an admin or deployer takes a state-changing path the contract reserves to the token issuer, and a issuer who set 0 to forbid selling has it silently set to 20%. Both principals are named in this file, so the source establishes the mismatch without any outside documentation. The class and the reading are this adjudication's; the line is the report's stated one, widened by the pipeline to the declaration containing it.
